Calculate age-specific fertility rates, optionally by current parity

Source: R/calc_demographic_measures.R
calculate_fertility_rates.Rd

Report maternal births per woman-year, including time excluded by minimum birth spacing. Only female rows are returned. Current parity is reconstructed from all recorded maternal births, including pre-window births and deceased children; custom person parity columns are ignored. Each birth counts at the parity immediately before it and advances subsequent exposure. Simultaneous births progress successively in recorded person-row order.

Usage

calculate_fertility_rates(
  population,
  time_breaks,
  age_breaks,
  by_union_type = FALSE,
  by_group = FALSE,
  parity_breaks = NULL,
  unrealized = FALSE,
  conf.level = NULL
)

Arguments

population

A hammel_population or persons data frame.

time_breaks

Strictly increasing finite period boundaries in years.

age_breaks

Strictly increasing nonnegative age boundaries in years. If the final boundary is finite, Inf is appended to create an open-ended final age band starting at that boundary.

by_union_type

Logical, default FALSE. Require population histories and return union_type rows for unpartnered and each discovered union type, without overall rows. Untyped histories use partnered/unpartnered. Births tied to dissolution or conversion retain the ending type; deaths use the type immediately before death. Typed overlapping histories are rejected; untyped overlapping coverage is merged. For formation rates use calculate_union_rates() or calculate_marriage_rates().

by_group

Logical, default FALSE. With TRUE, require a persons group column and return the complete period/age/sex grid for each group appearing in the person history, in first-occurrence order. Labels retain their type. Exposure and deaths use the person's group; births use the mother's group, even when the child has a different group. Combines with by_union_type. No pooled group row is added. Unknown-mother births remain in the single period-level unassigned_births attribute, without a group assignment.

parity_breaks

NULL to pool parities, or strictly increasing nonnegative integer boundaries starting at zero. Bands are half-open. A finite final boundary receives Inf, as for age breaks.

unrealized

Logical, default FALSE. With TRUE, the population must come from simulate(); add unrealized_births (expected births dropped from fertility cells that had members but no eligible woman, from simulation$unrealized_births) and rate_fertility_adjusted = (births + unrealized_births) / person_years. Values are NA where they cannot be attributed exactly: periods before the most recent simulation's start (restarts keep only the latest run's record), breaks that cut through a recorded one-year period or fertility cell, and union_type or parity strata the fertility schedule did not use.

conf.level

NULL (default) to omit confidence intervals, or a finite numeric scalar strictly between 0 and 1. Adds conf_low and conf_high from two-sided exact stats::poisson.test() intervals for observed event counts over exposure. Bounds are NA at zero exposure. For fertility, these describe the observed rate, not the unrealized-adjusted rate.

Value

A tibble with period, age, sex (female), person_years, births and rate_fertility; optional parity_start/parity_end, group and union_type, and with unrealized = TRUE, unrealized_births and rate_fertility_adjusted. Unknown-mother births are in the period-level unassigned_births attribute.
